- Need: evidence of signatory authority (Certificate of Incumbency OR signed board resolution) for the person who signed the W-8BEN-E.
- Need: vendor portal enrollment completed (bank details + KB document upload).
- Need: statement of US-sourced income (if any) and withholding preference for PAYE where applicable.

Anya — if you can send the Certificate of Incumbency and the contact details for the signing officer, I’ll queue this with Finance and Procurement. Once we have signatory evidence + bank details in the portal, PO generation typically takes 1–2 business days.
